metadata.title: ₵h@mpi0nz Pr3dict0r — Champions League predictions on Chiliz
metadata.description: Stake CHZ, predict the 90-minute scorelines of the UEFA Champions League 2026/27, climb the leaderboards from matchday one to Madrid.

layout.footer: Design inspired by BigMac Bobby · Built on Chiliz Chain · Not affiliated with or endorsed by UEFA

health.delayed: Results are delayed — our data feed is having a moment. The leaderboard will catch up automatically; nothing is lost.

home.intro: Stake CHZ, call the 90-minute scorelines, and climb two leaderboards from matchday one to Madrid — while a UEFA-fed oracle does the admin work.

enter.heading: Pick your pass
enter.intro: Early birds play the whole season for 1,100 CHZ. Latecomers join the knockout for 550 CHZ the moment season sales close — same matches, same money, fresh leaderboard. Under 20 entrants in a stage? Everyone gets every wei back.
enter.confirmInWallet: Confirm the entry in your wallet…
enter.waitingOnchain: Waiting for the entry to land on-chain…
enter.confirmed: Entry confirmed — you’re in. Go predict!
enter.notConfirmed: Not confirmed after 120s — check your wallet.

knockout.lockedWarning: ⚠ {count, plural, one {# knockout match has} other {# knockout matches have}} already locked — you can no longer score on:
knockout.ackLabel: I understand these score 0 points for me

play.heading: Call every scoreline
play.intro: Dial your 90-minute scorelines, lock the whole matchday in one transaction, and edit any pick freely until 60 minutes before its kickoff — changing your mind just re-pays cents of gas.
play.notConfigured: NEXT_PUBLIC_PREDICTOR_ADDRESS is not set — deploy the contract and add the proxy address to .env.local.
play.emptySlate: No matches on the slate yet — the oracle hasn’t published fixtures.
play.confirmBatch: Confirm {count, plural, one {# prediction} other {# predictions}} in your wallet — one transaction…
play.waitingBatch: Waiting for the batch to land on-chain…
play.updatedSingle: Prediction updated — you can change it again until {time} (T-60).
play.updatedMany: {count} predictions updated — you can change each again until 60 minutes before its kickoff (T-60).
play.batchNotConfirmed: Batch not confirmed after 120s — check your wallet and Chiliscan before retrying.

submitBar.review: Review before signing — {count, plural, one {# change} other {# changes}}
submitBar.lockIn: Lock in {count, plural, one {# prediction} other {# predictions}}
submitBar.gasCopy: One transaction for the whole matchday — a full 18-match batch costs ≈ 1.1 CHZ (~$0.05) in gas. Editing later just re-pays it.

standings.tagline: Two boards pay · one crown rules
standings.heading: Standings
standings.noEntrants: No entrants yet — be the first.
standings.footnote: Points compute live from chain state — no settlement transactions exist. Season View crowns the Ultimate ₵h@mpi0n (trophy NFT lands with slice 11).

claim.confirm: Confirm the claim in your wallet…
claim.claimed: Claimed — the CHZ is in your wallet. 🏆
claim.notConfirmed: Not confirmed after 120s — check your wallet.
claim.banner: ★ You finished in the {stage} top 20 — {amount} CHZ claimable

hallOfFame.heading: Hall of Fame
hallOfFame.emptyPlinth: The plinth is empty. The Ultimate ₵h@mpi0n is crowned after the final in Madrid — best combined Stage 1 + Stage 2 score takes the trophy NFT.

profile.heading: Claim your name
profile.intro: The leaderboard shows a flag and a username, not a wallet address. Pick a handle (unique per chain), pick your colours, sign one message — done. No email, no password: your wallet is your login.

form.connectPrompt: Connect your wallet to claim a username. Socios.com Wallet works first-class.
form.usernameHint: Unique per chain — this is your leaderboard name.
form.signNote: You’ll sign one readable message (no transaction, no gas). Contract wallets like Socios.com Wallet are verified via ERC-1271.
form.checkWallet: Check your wallet and sign the message…
form.saved: Profile saved — your flag flies on the leaderboard.

telegram.title: Telegram (optional)
telegram.intro: Link your Telegram to get lock reminders and the community group invite. Opt-in, one-tap unlink, never required.
telegram.openLinkNote: Open the link and press START — the code lives 15 minutes.
telegram.unlinked: Unlinked — the bot forgets you entirely.
